newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks rise in early trade helped by dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks rise in early trade helped by dollar.

text.p: Tokyo stocks strengthened in early Monday morning trade, lifted by purchases of bellwether issues such as Sony Corp, which rose to a new record high, brokers said.
They said the mood was being brightened somewhat by the rise of the dollar against the yen above 117 yen.
After 23 minutes of trade, the Nikkei average was up 68.31 points or 0.34 percent at 20,457.85. Its September futures had risen 50 to 20,470.
